_comment: Activates the 9 EVM static precompiles on arkdevnet_9000-1, matching the
mainnet launch set. Without this the chain's Cosmos modules are unreachable
from Solidity: no delegating, reward claiming, IBC transfer, bank send, or
governance vote from a contract. See issue #37.
DECIDED: enable every precompile actually registered by the binary. The set
is a module param, so governance can narrow it later without a coordinated
binary upgrade — which is why enabling the full working set at launch is the
reversible choice, not the risky one. Rationale per precompile lives in
docs/decisions/proposals/precompile-enablement-proposal.md.
0x...0803 (Vesting) is DELIBERATELY ABSENT and must not be added. The fork
advertises that address in evmtypes.AvailableStaticPrecompiles but ships no
implementation for it, and activating an address the keeper has no contract
for makes GetStaticPrecompileInstance panic ("precompiled contract not
stored in memory") — reachable by anyone over eth_call. ValidatePrecompiles
does not catch this; see app/precompiles.go and its test.
MsgUpdateParams replaces the params struct wholesale — every field must be
present, not just the one being changed. Values below are the live devnet
params with active_static_precompiles populated and nothing else. CONFIRM
against `arkd query evm params` before submitting: if the live chain differs
from what is written here, this proposal will silently reset those fields.
Submit:  arkd tx gov submit-proposal \
networks/devnet/proposals/evm-active-precompiles.json \
--from <key> --chain-id arkdevnet_9000-1 \
--gas auto --gas-adjustment 1.5 --gas-prices 1000000000esp
The gas price is not optional and not the value the node advertises — see
this directory's README for the full explanation.
Verify:  arkd query evm params
Then actually call them: deploy scripts/chaos/contracts/Precompiles.sol's
PrecompileHarness and exercise each address. A populated param list only
proves the param was set, not that dispatch works.
metadata: Activate the 9 registered EVM static precompiles on arkdevnet
title: Activate EVM static precompiles (staking, bank, gov, distribution, ICS20, slashing, p256, bech32, distrclaim)
summary: Populates evm.params.active_static_precompiles with the 9 precompiles the binary actually registers, making the chain's Cosmos modules callable from Solidity. Excludes 0x...0803 (Vesting), which the fork advertises but does not implement — activating it panics the node on call. Mirrors the mainnet launch set so the devnet is representative.
